Getting 4 was nice since I often misplace my clips, and the size makes it easier to find them when I inevitably have to go looking. reviews.x: I used to have an octopus clip years ago that I absolutely loved, and so I bought these thinking they'd be the same, but they turned out larger than I expected. reviews.x: Don’t believe the good reviews — these are a joke.  They are impossible to open — the hinges are so stiff and the handles are so slippery (and small) that you need two hands to open them.  The problem with needing to use two hands is that there’s not another hand left over to hold your hair while you struggle to open the clip. I have a hard time finding hair claws that will hold my long thick hair. I prefer hair claws to save my hair from breakage with hair ties. This this the FIRST TIME I’ve found some that work perfectly without my hair falling out right away. Love them and will definitely be ordering more!

reviews.t: Will fit around thick hair twist
reviews.x: These 8.5 c.m clips are deep and wide enough to hold my thick shoulder-length hair gathered up and folded over twice into a twist - unlike 95% of other claw clips that just aren’t big enough - exactly as I expected - they are absolutely worth the  price of less than $12 that I paid for 4 of them. The clip has a tooth on the inside of the inner teeth to help secure the hair. It held without anything slipping. The spring is very tight, which helps keep it in place  - It’s also tricky to operate wi

I have had constant struggles with hair clips because I am clumsy and drop them all the time - meaning I break a lot of hair clips. I finally found a size I like that can hold my bun in place and not slip. When you go to the stores and find clips this size a single clip can cost you >$3-4 and with my luck I go through them quickly. I am so happy with this purchase because the clips seem to be a lot sturdier than the ones I buy in store (the scrinch/scrunch brand idk). In addition, the spring see

The value for money can't be beat here, but if you have thick or unruly hair you should know there's no sticky grip stuff on the claws like major brands (not that the product is advertised to have such a thing) and that has a huge impact on holding all that hair. Like, these won't hold steady, they slip. But if I put my hair in a loose pony and twirl it up under the clip it seems to do ok. They ARE strong, though, and not made cheaply.

These are awesome. I bought them after my scunci clip broke and I actually like these a lot more. They’re bigger and they stay in place better. I need to put my hair up everyday for work and trying to stay away from hair ties and Bobby pins due to breakage. I have long, thin hair and these were able to cover my entire bun and keep it in place all day. Love ‘em!

These hair clips are phenomenal. They are super sturdy, hold hair in place great and stand up to wear and tear. My hair is ALWAYS up in a hair clip and I have A LOT of hair (down to my behind). I brush it up and back when it's wet and then twist it into a tight bun and this clip holds it into place all day! It doesn't come loose at all. These clips are great!!  So sturdy and bigger than I expected. I have thick hair, so I buy the big store-bought ones that come with 1 in a pack.  This is such a great value for 4 and stronger than the store-bought ones which break really easily.  It’s slightly smaller than the store-bought ones, but just as strong if not stronger. The gauge of the wire is thicker than the store-bought ones. I’ve already order the black ones. Extremely, happy with this product and I rarely write reviews!

It is certainly sturdy and durable and cheap but it is too big, hard to open and uncomfortable.  Threw it away as I didn't want to bother returning it.  I baught these to replace one that I had for five years, I really miss them.  Do not advise to buy it.

My hair feels secured and haven't had any issues with pulling or with pieces slowly falling out. I recently added a bunch of layers to my hair and it still holds my hair up securely and comfortably. This 4 pack of tortoise colored octopus hair clips are not as heavy a plastic as my single purchased one from years ago.  Neither is it as darkly colored.  They also take some finger strength to open.  I have to start it with my other hand.  I do like that they are lighter in weight.  More comfortable to wear and they really hold my hair securely.  I haven't had them long so can't attest to their durability or sturdiness but I like them so far.

I've had these for about a year now and all four are still in like new condition. I was hesitant to buy these because of all the reviews complaining about how hard they are to open, but I've never had any issues and never found it difficult. Idk maybe people just don't know how to properly use them, but I would definitely recommend it! They are very sturdy and it keeps all my hair up all day with no problem

Some of the clips have been too long which I didn’t find very comfortable.  I wish these clips opened easier because I don’t have a lot of strength in my hands.  However, it is doable for me. claims.text: Many reviewers find the clips sturdy, durable, and good value, especially compared to store-bought or name-brand clips.
The clips hold thick, long, or curly hair securely, with several reviewers saying they finally found clips that work for their hair type.
Some reviewers find the clips too large, stiff, hard to open, and slippery, making them difficult or uncomfortable to use.
Several reviewers note the clips lack a non-slip grip, so they may not hold steady for thick or unruly hair.
Reviewers appreciate getting multiple clips for a low price, which is convenient for misplacing or breaking them.

qa.q: Will these hold thick long hair without slipping?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say they hold long thick hair all day without falling out [1][3], while others report slipping and not holding steady with thick or unruly hair [2][6].

claims.text: They keep all my hair up all day with no problem for long thick hair.
They work perfectly for long thick hair without falling out right away.
They don't feel as tight and secure as desired for thick hair.
They slip and won't hold steady with thick or unruly hair.

qa.q: Are the clips durable enough for daily use?
qa.answer: Reviews are mixed on durability: several call the clips sturdy and long-lasting [1][2][3], with one noting they stand up to wear and tear [3], but another reviewer says they haven't had them long enough to attest to durability [6].

claims.text: The clips are sturdy and seem like they'll last quite a while.
They are stronger than store-bought ones that break easily.
They stand up to wear and tear.
One reviewer hasn't had them long enough to attest to their durability.

qa.q: Are they comfortable to wear for long periods?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on comfort: one reviewer found them "most uncomfortable" and too big [3], while another noted some similar clips were too long and uncomfortable but did not find these so [4]. No review directly describes wearing these for long periods, though several say they hold hair all day [1][2].

claims.text: One reviewer found the clip most uncomfortable and too big.

Reviewers say the clips keep hair up all day.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is this good value for four clips?
qa.answer: Reviews describe getting four clips as a great value, especially compared to store prices where a single clip can cost over $3-4 [1][4]. However, one reviewer received two broken clips out of four, so opinions on value differ [6].
